workspace_code_snapshot_after_replay.limitation: Captured after replay; does not reconstruct the exact dirty worktree at execution time and is not asserted as the historical run code identity.

interpretation_limits: Input and output digests establish byte identity, not semantic validity or truth.
The runner used no LLM or external network and performed bounded local analysis only.
Historical and current run comparison is byte-based; timestamps and non-deterministic metadata can change bytes.
The current run state completed_bounded is an execution state, not a complete or verified incident reconstruction.
Source independence, claim truth, coverage completeness, and physical-event causality remain unestablished.
